name: localis
summary: Fast, offline access to comprehensive data for countries, subdivisions, cities, macroregions, currencies, languages and scripts. Built on ISO 3166, ISO 4217, ISO 639-3, ISO 15924, GeoNames and Unicode CLDR datasets (updated monthly) with support for exact lookups, filtering, and fuzzy search.
